title: dantia palustris
intro: Dantia palustris, commonly known as marsh dantia, is a plant species that belongs to the family Apiaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and prevent infections. The therapeutic actions of Dantia palustris include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve flatulence, and treat respiratory conditions such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of Dantia palustris include sesquiterpenes, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
